description: A director of student services must finalize one-day substitute coverage for three seventh-grade classrooms while their regular teachers attend district training, including the substitute assignment and required operating commitments, with input from a grade-level lead teacher, the human-resources staffing coordinator, and the school nurse.

shared_context.S1: The regular teachers of seventh-grade classrooms 7A, 7B, and 7C will attend district training on the same school day.
shared_context.S2: Three district-approved substitutes are available for that day: Casey, Jordan, and Morgan.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Monroe makes the binding decision about substitute assignments and the operating conditions for the coverage plan.
shared_context.S4: The school's weekly coverage huddle includes a routine check with the grade-level lead teacher, the staffing coordinator, and the school nurse before the assignment is finalized.

PF1.text: Classroom 7B has a scheduled chemistry demonstration and district procedure requires a science-certified substitute to lead that lesson; Casey is the only one of the three available substitutes with current science certification. Ms. Ibrahim added the demonstration to her lesson notes this week, but it has not been entered into the coverage request.

PF2.text: Classroom 7A has a scheduled language-support block for four recently arrived students, and the block must be led by a substitute with bilingual authorization; Jordan is the only available substitute with that authorization. Mr. Keane confirmed the authorization in the staffing database this week, but the coverage roster has not yet been updated.

PF3.text: A student assigned to classroom 7C uses an insulin pump, and the student's health plan requires an adult trained in diabetes response to remain available in that classroom; Morgan is the only available substitute with current district diabetes-response training. Nurse Alvarez verified the training records this week, but has not yet attached the health coverage note to the request.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan must be assigned to classroom 7A.
Casey must be assigned to classroom 7B.
Morgan must be assigned to classroom 7C.
A science-certification coverage commitment for 7B must be recorded.
A bilingual language-support commitment for 7A must be recorded.
A diabetes-response coverage commitment for 7C must be recorded.
The three classrooms must have different substitutes.

content_checks.C7: decisions['assignments']['7A'] != decisions['assignments']['7B'] and decisions['assignments']['7A'] != decisions['assignments']['7C'] and decisions['assignments']['7B'] != decisions['assignments']['7C']

decisive_facts.why: The 7B lesson changes from an ordinary substitute assignment to Casey specifically, and adds a science-certification coverage commitment.
The 7A language-support block changes the assignment to Jordan specifically and adds a bilingual language-support commitment.
The 7C health-plan requirement changes the assignment to Morgan specifically, adds diabetes-response coverage, and requires the nurse's fact to be cited.
